title: Retrieval Versus Mid-luteal Endometrial Scratching (ES) for Intra Cytoplasmic Sperm Injection (ICSI)
brief_summary: ES is a procedure used to help embryos to implant more successfully after In-Vitro Fertilization (IVF) , ICSI in patients who had failed cycles in spite of transfer of good quality embryos. New researches and evidence suggests that scratching the uterine endometrium causes a repair reaction in patients may increase embryo implantation rate . In spit of the optimum timing of scratching not finally determined, the usual timing to perform ES is approximately one week before starting IVF, ICSI treatment . our study aims to compare other time of scratching which is the scratching at retrieval time.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with at least one previous failed ICSI cycles, Good responders in the previous ICSI cycle and Less than or equal to 35 years

Exclusion Criteria:. We excluded patients with; Presence of intramural fibroid distorting the endometrial cavity/sub mucous myoma/a Sherman's syndrome, Presence of son graphically detected hydrosalpinx, Patient age more than 35 years
